crumbCoach.title: Crumb Coach
crumbCoach.description: Launch-readiness engineering for a SaaS platform that helps artisan bakers run their cottage-food business.
crumbCoach.summary: A SaaS platform for artisan sourdough bakers, built as a Turborepo + pnpm monorepo on Supabase. Led the web app's launch-readiness: a subscriptions and billing system on Stripe Connect, Supabase-JWT auth with Postgres-backed sessions, a mobile-to-backend bridge, a security-hardening campaign, and a full TypeScript and schema-drift stabilization.
crumbCoach.longDescription: CrumbCoach is a SaaS platform that helps artisan sourdough and cottage-food bakers run orders, recipes, inventory, and customers. It's a Turborepo + pnpm monorepo with a React web front end, an Express back end, an Expo mobile app, and a shared types package, all on Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions). The work centered on making the web app launch-ready: designing the subscriptions and billing subsystem from scratch on Stripe Connect, rebuilding authentication on Supabase JWT with Postgres-backed sessions, and bridging the mobile app to the web backend through a dedicated API surface. A sustained security campaign added rate limiting, CSRF, schema validation and audit trails; a systematic schema-drift audit and a TypeScript stabilization (web and mobile type errors driven to zero) hardened the codebase.

keyFeatures.Subscriptions & Billing: Tiered Pro/Free gating built on Stripe Connect
keyFeatures.Auth & Sessions: Supabase-JWT login with Postgres-backed sessions and CSRF
keyFeatures.Mobile-to-Backend Bridge: Shared API so the mobile app reuses web business logic
keyFeatures.Security Hardening: Rate limiting, schema validation, audit trails, and CVE remediation
keyFeatures.Schema-Drift Cleanup: Audited database, types, and ORM to a consistent, verified state

techDescriptions.TypeScript: End-to-end type safety, errors driven to zero
techDescriptions.Express: Node back end and domain route modules
techDescriptions.Supabase: Postgres, Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions
techDescriptions.Turborepo: pnpm monorepo across web, mobile, and shared

crumbCoach.techImpl: The web app pairs a React front end with an Express back end, sharing a typed Supabase data layer (Drizzle ORM plus the Supabase HTTP client) so web and mobile see identical data. Billing runs on Stripe Connect with destination charges and idempotent webhook handling; auth uses Supabase JWT with Postgres-backed sessions, and a cached server-state layer keeps the client in sync. A schema-drift audit aligned the live database, generated types, and ORM, and a TypeScript pass drove web and mobile type errors to zero.

connectInvest.title: Connect Invest
connectInvest.description: High-fidelity marketing site for a real-estate investment platform, built pixel-for-pixel from Figma and fully responsive.
connectInvest.summary: The public marketing site for Connect Invest, a real-estate investment platform. I implemented it almost end-to-end from a high-fidelity Figma design, responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, inside a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo, and expanded the home, portfolio and about sections. Sensitive endpoints got rate limiting.
connectInvest.longDescription: The public-facing marketing site for Connect Invest, a real-estate investment platform built as a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo. The marketing app was implemented almost entirely from a high-fidelity Figma design, translated pixel-for-pixel into a Next.js build with fully responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop. The work spanned a strong expansion of the home, portfolio, and about sections (components, content, and assets), alongside mobile UX refinements and app-distribution links. Abuse and risk controls were added through rate limiting on sensitive endpoints, with ongoing dependency maintenance and environment tuning to keep the site fast and reliable.

keyFeatures.Figma-to-Code Fidelity: Marketing site implemented pixel-for-pixel from a high-fidelity Figma design
keyFeatures.Fully Responsive: Layouts tuned for mobile, tablet, and desktop
keyFeatures.Home & Portfolio: Expanded home, portfolio, and about components, content, and assets
keyFeatures.Monorepo Architecture: pnpm + Turborepo workspace shared across apps

techDescriptions.Next.js: React framework powering the marketing site
techDescriptions.Figma: Source design translated at high fidelity

connectInvest.techImpl: The marketing app is a Next.js + React build styled with Tailwind CSS, living in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo alongside the platform's web and mobile apps. A high-fidelity Figma design was translated to production with responsive breakpoints validated across mobile, tablet, and desktop. Sensitive endpoints are protected with rate limiting, and dependencies are kept current to maintain performance and security.

dailyAbide.title: The Daily Abide
dailyAbide.description: Navigation redesign and a full gamification layer for a faith-planner mobile app, taken from prototype to App Store-ready.
dailyAbide.summary: A daily faith-planner mobile app built with Expo and Supabase. Carried from a migrated prototype to publish-ready: a full navigation redesign (Stack to Tabs with a Home hub), an engagement layer of streaks, XP, and celebrations, security and CI/CD infrastructure from scratch, and iOS App Store compliance.
dailyAbide.longDescription: The Daily Abide is a daily faith-planner mobile app, built with Expo (SDK 54) on a Turborepo + pnpm monorepo and backed by Supabase (Auth, Postgres, RLS). The app was carried from a migrated prototype to a publish-ready product. That meant a complete navigation redesign, from a stack to a five-tab architecture with a Home hub (daily pulse ring, quick actions, inline scripture), and an entire engagement layer: streaks with idempotent daily tracking, XP and levels, and particle celebration overlays across the app. It also meant standing up the project's security and CI/CD from scratch (SAST, dependency audit, secret scanning, pre-commit hooks), stabilizing authentication against unresponsive-backend edge cases, and meeting Apple's App Store requirements, including in-app account deletion.

keyFeatures.Tab Navigation & Home Hub: Redesigned from a stack to 5 tabs with a daily-status Home hub
keyFeatures.Gamification Layer: Streaks, XP, levels, and idempotent daily tracking
keyFeatures.Security & CI/CD: SAST, dependency audit, secret scanning, and pre-commit hooks from scratch
keyFeatures.App Store Compliance: In-app account deletion and iOS submission readiness

dailyAbide.techImpl: The app uses file-based navigation over a provider tree spanning gesture handling, an error boundary, server-state caching, auth, and a celebration provider. Server state is cached with optimistic updates and cascade invalidation, and the UI is fluidly animated across tabs and celebration overlays. Supabase provides Auth, Postgres, and row-level security, with the session persisted locally. A from-scratch CI/CD pipeline adds SAST, dependency auditing, and secret scanning, and an RPC-backed delete-account flow satisfies Apple's requirements.

poa.title: POA Management System
poa.description: Planning and budget platform for EPN's Research Directorate: 500+ annual operating plans (POAs) under role-based access.
poa.summary: The Research Directorate tracked its annual operating plans by hand and closed a reporting cycle every three months. I built the platform that replaced that process: a FastAPI + React app managing 500+ POAs and thousands of related records for several director-level roles, with automated ETL and validation pipelines that turned the quarterly report into near real-time data. It was also my thesis project.
poa.longDescription: Role-based access control with JWT and bcrypt separates directors, planners and reviewers, each with their own budget-tracking and reporting views. The REST API runs on FastAPI with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations over PostgreSQL, every write is audit-logged for compliance, and the React + TypeScript front end keeps collaborative planning in sync in real time. Docker keeps development and deployment identical, and CI checks guard data integrity on every change.

keyFeatures.RBAC: Role-based access control with multiple user hierarchies
keyFeatures.Budget Tracking: Real-time monitoring and collaborative planning tools
keyFeatures.Audit Logging: Detailed activity tracking for regulatory compliance
keyFeatures.JWT Auth: Token-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing

techDescriptions.FastAPI: Async Python API for optimal performance

poa.techImpl: React + TypeScript frontend paired with FastAPI's async capabilities for optimal performance. PostgreSQL handles complex relational data with proper normalization. Docker ensures consistent deployment across environments. Security implemented via JWT authentication, bcrypt hashing, and parameterized queries for SQL injection prevention.

certificates.title: EPN Certificates Automation
certificates.description: Python pipeline that scrapes project data and generates multi-page academic certificates at scale.
certificates.summary: Producing the Research Directorate's certificates took a week of copy-paste every cycle. I automated the whole workflow: Selenium pulls the project records from the institutional system, Pandas validates and deduplicates them, and a template engine fills the multi-page certificates in batch, driven by a structured Excel input. Production dropped from one week to 30 minutes, for 200–300 certificates a year, with no manual intervention.
certificates.longDescription: Built for the Research Directorate's certificate process. Selenium extracts the project and student records from the institutional system, Pandas validates them and catches duplicates and errors, and a template engine fills the multi-page certificates in batch, with export to PDF and Excel. A Jupyter notebook drives and monitors each run, so the whole cycle happens from a structured Excel input with no manual intervention. What used to take a week now takes 30 minutes, for the 200–300 certificates issued every year.

keyFeatures.Batch Processing: Handles hundreds of certificates in a single run
keyFeatures.Web Scraping: Automated student data extraction from institutional systems
keyFeatures.Data Validation: Duplicate detection and error handling pipelines
keyFeatures.Multi-format Export: Output to PDF and Excel formats

techDescriptions.Pandas: Efficient data processing and validation pipelines

certificates.techImpl: Selenium drives browser automation to extract student records from institutional systems. Pandas pipelines clean, validate, and deduplicate data before processing. Template engine fills certificate templates in batch mode, cutting production from one week to 30 minutes.

travel.title: Travel Allowance Calculator
travel.description: Travel-allowance estimator for institutional trips: per-diem rules, live totals, multi-currency and a PDF breakdown.
travel.summary: A React app that estimates travel allowances from destination, duration and travel category, validates the form as you type, converts between currencies in real time and exports a detailed PDF breakdown for approval. Past trips feed better estimates, and the layout works on a phone so approvals can happen in the field.
travel.longDescription: A budget-planning application for business travel and institutional expenses. The system provides intelligent cost estimation based on destination, duration, and travel category, with real-time calculations and dynamic form validation. Features include multi-currency support, historical data tracking for better estimates, PDF export with detailed breakdown, and integration with institutional budget systems. The interface is designed for ease of use with step-by-step wizards, auto-save functionality, and responsive design for mobile approval workflows. Built with modern React practices including hooks and context API for state management.

keyFeatures.Cost Estimation: Intelligent calculations by destination, duration, and category
keyFeatures.Historical Data: Tracking past expenses for improved future estimates
keyFeatures.PDF Export: Detailed expense breakdown in downloadable reports

techDescriptions.React: UI framework with hooks and Context API for state management
techDescriptions.JavaScript: Dynamic calculations and form validation logic

travel.techImpl: Built on React with hooks (useState, useContext, useEffect) for reactive state management. Dynamic form validation runs on every input change for immediate feedback. PDF generation library produces formatted expense reports. Responsive design ensures usability on mobile devices for field approvals.

storycraft.title: StoryCraft Platform
storycraft.description: Collaborative writing platform built twice: as a monolith and as NestJS microservices.
storycraft.summary: A university project that compares two architectures for the same product. The microservices version splits auth, stories and notifications into NestJS services behind an API gateway that talk through events; the front end is React + Redux, SQL Server keeps story data transactional, and Docker Compose brings the whole stack up with one command. Writers co-author in real time over WebSocket, branch their narratives with version history and get AI writing suggestions.
storycraft.longDescription: A platform for collaborative creative writing that demonstrates both monolithic and microservices architectural patterns. Users can create, share, and co-author stories in real-time with version control and branching narratives. The platform implements WebSocket for real-time collaboration, NestJS microservices for scalability (auth service, story service, notification service), React with Redux for complex state management, and SQL Server for transactional data integrity. Features include character and plot management tools, AI-powered writing suggestions, publishing workflows, and community features like comments and ratings. The project showcases modern software architecture principles including API Gateway pattern, event-driven communication, and containerization with Docker Compose.

keyFeatures.Microservices: NestJS services for auth, stories, and notifications

techDescriptions.NestJS: Scalable microservices framework with dependency injection
techDescriptions.React: Frontend with Redux for complex state management
techDescriptions.SQL Server: Transactional data integrity for stories and users

storycraft.techImpl: Microservices architecture with separate auth, story, and notification services communicating via event-driven messages. API Gateway pattern routes client requests. WebSocket enables real-time collaboration. Docker Compose orchestrates the full multi-service stack for local development and deployment.

fitness.title: Fitness Tracker
fitness.description: Workout and nutrition tracker in ASP.NET Web Forms with a strict N-layer architecture.
fitness.summary: Built to practice enterprise .NET the strict way: Presentation, Business Logic and Data Access in separate projects, every database operation behind a parameterized stored procedure, Entity Framework for the ORM, and session management plus input validation on the web layer. Users create routines from an exercise library, log calories, follow their progress in charts and share achievements with others.
fitness.longDescription: A fitness management application built with ASP.NET Web Forms demonstrating enterprise-level architecture patterns. The application uses a strict N-Layer architecture separating Presentation, Business Logic, and Data Access layers for maintainability and testability. Features include personalized workout routine creation with exercise libraries, progress tracking with charts and statistics, calorie and nutrition logging, goal setting and achievement tracking, and social features for sharing progress. The backend implements stored procedures for data operations, Entity Framework for ORM, and includes proper exception handling and logging. Security features include input validation, SQL injection prevention, and session management.

keyFeatures.Progress Tracking: Charts and statistics for performance monitoring
keyFeatures.Social Sharing: Share progress and achievements with others

techDescriptions.ASP.NET: Web Forms framework for server-side rendering
techDescriptions.N-Layer architecture: Strict separation of Presentation, Business Logic, and Data Access layers
techDescriptions.SQL Server: Enterprise relational database with stored procedures

fitness.techImpl: Strict N-Layer architecture separates concerns: Presentation (Web Forms), Business Logic (C# classes), and Data Access (Entity Framework + stored procedures). All database operations use parameterized stored procedures to prevent SQL injection. Session management and input validation secure the application layer.

spaceInvaders.title: Space Invaders
spaceInvaders.description: The arcade classic rebuilt in Python and Pygame.
spaceInvaders.summary: A faithful Space Invaders in Pygame: sprite groups for aliens, bullets and player, collision detection, delta-time movement at 60 FPS, alien speed that climbs with each wave, power-ups and a persistent high score, all driven by a menu → game → game-over state machine. Small, but it's where I learned game loops and frame-independent movement.
spaceInvaders.longDescription: A faithful recreation of the iconic Space Invaders arcade game using Python and Pygame, demonstrating game development fundamentals and object-oriented programming. The game features smooth 60 FPS gameplay, sprite-based graphics with custom assets, collision detection systems, progressive difficulty with increasing alien speed, power-up mechanics, high score persistence, and sound effects. Technical highlights include game state management, entity component system for game objects, optimized rendering with sprite groups, and input handling with configurable controls. The project showcases understanding of game loops, frame-independent movement, and classic arcade game design patterns.

keyFeatures.Progressive Difficulty: Increasing alien speed and challenge scaling
keyFeatures.Power-ups: Collectible mechanics with high score persistence
keyFeatures.Sound & Collision: Audio effects and precise detection systems
keyFeatures.Entity Components: Component system for organized game objects

techDescriptions.Python: Core language for game logic and OOP architecture
techDescriptions.Pygame: 2D game development library with sprite and audio support

spaceInvaders.techImpl: Game loop runs at 60 FPS with delta-time for frame-independent movement. Entity component system manages all game objects (player, aliens, bullets, power-ups) through sprite groups for optimized rendering and collision detection. Game state machine handles transitions between menu, gameplay, and game-over screens.

godot2d.title: Godot Game 2D
godot2d.description: 2D platformer in Godot: traps, fruit for points and a trophy at the end.
godot2d.summary: A small platformer built to learn Godot's way of doing things: tilemap levels, a physics-based character with an animation state machine (idle, run, jump, hurt), traps that need timing, checkpoints, collectible fruit and a trophy that congratulates you at the end. Everything talks through Godot's signal system.
godot2d.longDescription: A 2D platformer game developed in Godot Engine showcasing fundamental game mechanics and level design principles. The game features physics-based character movement with jump mechanics, collectible system with scoring, hazard and trap mechanics requiring timing and skill, checkpoint system for player progression, and particle effects for visual feedback. Built using Godot's node-based scene system, GDScript for game logic, tilemap system for level design, and animation state machines for character states. The project demonstrates understanding of 2D game physics, collision layers, signal system for event handling, and game feel through careful tuning of movement parameters.

keyFeatures.Collectibles: Scoring system with pickups throughout levels
keyFeatures.Hazards & Traps: Obstacles requiring precise timing and skill
keyFeatures.Particle Effects: Visual feedback for actions and events

techDescriptions.Godot: Node-based game engine with integrated physics, animation, and scene management

godot2d.techImpl: Godot's node-based scene tree structures game objects with parent-child relationships. GDScript handles character controller logic with physics-based movement. Tilemap system enables rapid level design. Animation state machines manage character states (idle, run, jump, hurt). Signal system enables decoupled event handling between game nodes.

godot3d.title: Godot Game 3D
godot3d.description: First 3D project in Godot: a cube climbs a mountain and collects the coins at the top.
godot3d.summary: My first step into 3D: a cube with a physics-based controller climbs a generated mountain terrain while a camera follows with lerp smoothing. It covers 3D collisions, spatial transforms, lighting and shadows, and a win condition with feedback when you reach the coins.
godot3d.longDescription: An exploration of 3D game development using Godot Engine, featuring a challenging mountain climbing experience with physics-based movement. The game implements 3D character controller with camera follow system, terrain generation and environmental design, collectible system with 3D spatial awareness, lighting and shadow effects for atmosphere, and victory condition with reward feedback. Technical aspects include Godot's 3D physics engine, spatial nodes and transforms, camera positioning algorithms, mesh and material systems, and 3D collision detection. The project explores fundamental concepts of 3D game development including vector mathematics, quaternion rotations, and level design in three dimensions.

keyFeatures.3D Controller: Character movement with camera follow system

techDescriptions.Godot: 3D game engine with physics, spatial rendering, and camera systems

godot3d.techImpl: Godot's 3D physics engine drives character movement with proper collision detection on terrain meshes. Camera follow algorithm uses Lerp for smooth tracking with configurable lag. Quaternion rotations handle 3D character orientation. Mesh and material systems create the visual environment with dynamic lighting for atmosphere.

intro.bio: I'm a software engineer from Quito, Ecuador. In the last two years I've built and hardened real products: a bakers' SaaS with Stripe Connect billing, the security campaign of a live fintech platform, a faith-planner app shipped to the App Store, and institutional tools that cut a three-month reporting cycle to minutes. Today I also build benchmark datasets and evaluate code-generation models. What I care about is what happens after launch: typed schemas, CI that fails early, and interfaces that match the design to the pixel.

bullets: Delivered 778 approved tasks across 11 workstreams, producing benchmark datasets and expert evaluations for code-generation and code-editing models that capture real developer workflows and expose model failure modes.
Reviewer on 406 of those tasks (52%): audited peer submissions for correctness and rule compliance, applied corrections directly, and returned written feedback to each contributor.

Annotated natural-language queries against production repositories with commit-pinned evidence (functions, line ranges, search rationale), verified generated answers against technical documentation, and scored AI-generated web interfaces against structured rubrics.

Took CrumbCoach, a bakers' SaaS monorepo (React, Node.js/Express, React Native/Expo, Supabase, Drizzle ORM, Stripe, Turborepo), from feature-rich but fragile to production-ready: subscriptions and billing on Stripe Connect, a rebuilt auth layer, the mobile-to-backend bridge, and the calendar, orders and storefront gaps closed across web, mobile and backend.

Led phased security hardening on Connect Invest, a live fintech investment platform: closed IDOR, CSRF and CORS gaps, added Zod validation, server-side pricing controls and audit trails, and shipped KYC/MFA flows and webhook security while keeping CI green through dependency drift.
Shipped a corporate marketing website on Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Bootstrap 5, plus a CI/CD pipeline that runs CodeQL and Semgrep on every push, deployed on Vercel.
Designed and operated backend services, frontend modules, and data pipelines (Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React) supporting institutional planning workflows with hundreds of active records.
Implemented role-based access control and data validation rules, improving data consistency and reducing rework during reporting cycles.
Consolidated bug fixes, dependency upgrades, and input sanitization, restoring 100% platform availability.
Delivered hands-on training in digital productivity tools to rural educators and senior adults, contributing to an 85% completion rate across 200+ participants.

Supervised 70+ instructors and validated weekly deliverables for 120+ learners, with structured feedback every week to 20 educators and 40–50 learners to keep the curriculum on track and the teaching quality high.

Ran the chapter's budget, event pricing and promotion (social media and event pages), and kept the relationship with collaborators and sponsors going between events.
